import re

def parse_grid_block(text, label):
    m=re.search(re.escape(label)+r' \((\d+)x(\d+)\):\n(.*?)(?=\n(?:Demo pair|Same instance|Wrong attempts|Reply with)|\Z)',text,re.S)
    if not m: raise ValueError(label)
    h,w=map(int,m.group(1,2)); rows=[[int(x) for x in line.split()] for line in m.group(3).strip().splitlines()]
    assert len(rows)==h and all(len(row)==w for row in rows),(len(rows),[len(x) for x in rows])
    return rows
pairs=[]
for i in [1,2]:
    t=user_msgs[i]
    pairs.append((parse_grid_block(t,f'Demo pair {1 if i==1 else 2} input'),parse_grid_block(t,f'Demo pair {1 if i==1 else 2} output')))
print([(len(a),len(b)) for a,b in pairs],pairs[1][1][0])
